name: Edgar Abasov
now: Running paperclaw — an agent that keeps checking whether the solar parks promised around Berlin actually get built.

entries.title: German C1
entries.text: Potsdam, starting soon.

entries.title: Build a world-class startup
entries.text: Every project in this log is a shot at it. The goal is to grow one of them into a large company.

entries.title: paperclaw
entries.text: An always-on agent that checks 571 registered solar parks in Berlin/Brandenburg against the official registry and Sentinel-2 satellite images, and flags megawatts that exist only on paper. Built for the NVIDIA Berlin Claw Agent Challenge.

entries.title: Wortweg
entries.text: A daily German word puzzle: trace a word on the grid, get its der/die/das, plural and a real example. A1–C1, free, no signup, no ads.

entries.title: Berlin Flat Search
entries.text: My Telegram bot for the Berlin/Potsdam flat hunt. It watches Kleinanzeigen, posts each new listing with rent, size and rooms, flags the cheap ones, and lets me mark them saved, applied or removed from the chat.

entries.title: ClipVault
